title.en: Can one small evidence capsule survive independent acceptance?
title.ru: Может ли маленькая капсула доказательства пройти независимую приёмку?

hypothesis.en: A claim, an exact source window of at most 500 tokens, one sender-highlighted exact span, and versioned source coordinates are enough for ordinary code to reject broken packets and for a frozen reranker to keep useful windows without trusting the sender's claim.
hypothesis.ru: Утверждения, точного окна источника до 500 токенов, выделенного отправителем точного места и координат версии источника достаточно, чтобы обычный код отсеял сломанные пакеты, а замороженный reranker сохранил полезные окна, не доверяя утверждению отправителя.

packet_contract: claim: a short sender-written statement; not trusted by this gate
evidence_window: exact UTF-8 source bytes, at most 500 Qwen tokens
candidate_evidence: an exact subrange inside evidence_window selected by the sender
source: source_id, source_version, source hash, and exact evidence-window byte coordinates

checks: source SHA-256 matches the frozen source bytes
evidence-window byte range is valid and matches both text and SHA-256
candidate-evidence byte range is inside the window and matches both text and SHA-256
evidence_window is at most 500 Qwen tokens
mechanical_gate.success: 24/24 expected decisions; 16/16 intact accepted; 0/8 broken accepted

relevance_gate.input: question + evidence_window only; claim and candidate_evidence are hidden from the model
relevance_gate.instruction: Given a user question and one evidence window, decide whether the window contains information that helps answer the question.

locked_reporting: show every mechanical decision and reason
show every reranker score and TAKE / NOT_SURE / DROP decision
separate results by 100, 250, and 500 token target and by evidence position
not_tested: whether the claim is supported by candidate_evidence
whether sender-highlighted evidence is the best evidence
truth or trustworthiness of the source
how the sender found the evidence window in its memory
claim_boundary: One public synthetic English development set. This test checks packet integrity and whole-window relevance only. It must not be described as proof that claims are true or supported.
